test_case.name: Long Architecture & Data Pipeline
test_case.prompt: Analyze this distributed telemetry pipeline: 50 IoT sensors publish events to Apache Kafka every 5 seconds. An ingestion consumer worker reads messages from Kafka, parses and validates JSON schemas, enriches the payloads with customer metadata from PostgreSQL, and writes the transformed events in micro-batches to ClickHouse. The system is experiencing high consumer lag during peak hours, occasional OOM crashes in the enrichment workers, and slow analytical query execution in ClickHouse. Propose a step-by-step optimization plan covering consumer group tuning, PostgreSQL connection pooling and caching strategies, ClickHouse partitioning and sorting keys, and memory profiling. Provide clear configuration recommendations and architecture diagrams.
